title: Hop limit clamping prevents flood amplification attacks
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Lines: 372-375

The RREQ parser clamps `hop_limit` to `MAX_HOP_LIMIT` (15):
```rust
let hop_limit = data[1].min(MAX_HOP_LIMIT);
```

This prevents an attacker from sending RREQ with `hop_limit=255` to cause excessive network-wide propagation beyond the intended expanding ring limits [4, 8, 15]. Good defensive coding with security comment.
